template.name: Supertrend AT v1.0
template.notes: The SuperTrend line is approximated by EMA(10) with the documented SupertrendLength 10 and Multiplier 3 on ATR(10); the entry is the documented down-to-up flip above the band and the exit is the loss of the bullish regime. RiskPerTrade 2% and RewardRatio 3 size the position and its target from the previous Supertrend value, which the DSL cannot express, so the stop fields are null.
